title: South African Sign Language (SASL) Basic and Intermediate Short Learning Programmes
organisation: University of the Free State - Dept of SASL and Deaf Studies
description: Short learning programmes that teach SASL so participants can converse with Deaf people. Offered on the Bloemfontein campus, at a venue provided by the client, or online. Phone: +27 51 401 2476. Ask the university for the next intake dates.
accessibility_notes: Taught by a Department of SASL and Deaf Studies.

title: Basic Conversational South African Sign Language (online)
organisation: Wits Centre for Deaf Studies with DigitalCampus
description: Eight-week online short course (5 to 7 learning hours a week, learn anytime) for people who want to learn basic SASL: friends and family of Deaf people and colleagues. Phone: 087 023 0888.

title: Teach South African Sign Language: Trainer course (for Deaf SASL users)
description: A 10-week online certificate of competence course for Deaf first-language SASL users who want to design and teach a beginner SASL course. Requirements include Grade 12, South African citizenship, moderate written English and a computer with a camera. 2026 dates have passed, so ask the Language Centre for the 2027 dates.
accessibility_notes: Live online sessions twice a week. Designed for Deaf SASL users.

title: South African Sign Language Beginner Level 1A
description: Practical short course introducing SASL, taught by a Deaf presenter. The 2026 fee was R7 200 and the 2026 dates have passed, so ask the Language Centre for the 2027 dates.
accessibility_notes: Some sessions are supported by SASL interpreting.
